### Target Specification Document
e.g., `docs/02_Mathematics/SIMULATION_MATH_SPEC.md`

Clear description of the proposed architectural change or addition.

### Rationale

### Dependencies Affected

### Alignment with Core Principles
How does this change preserve strict determinism and zero-GC operational constraints?
